title: Cloud Engineer Deep‑Dive Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step guide to master advanced cloud engineering on AWS, GCP, or Azure, focusing on best practices, large‑scale projects, and professional readiness. Follow the phases to build depth, showcase work, and land a senior role.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Solidify core cloud concepts and essential services.

milestones.title: Cloud fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Explain core cloud models, services, and provider differences.

tasks.title: Read AWS Overview whitepaper
tasks.description: Study the official AWS Overview of Amazon Web Services document to grasp global infrastructure and service categories.

tasks.title: Watch GCP fundamentals video series
tasks.description: Complete the first three videos of Google Cloud Fundamentals on YouTube to compare compute, storage, and networking models.

tasks.title: Summarize key differences in a table
tasks.description: Create a side‑by‑side table of AWS, GCP, and Azure core services for compute, storage, and networking.

tasks.title: Set up free tier accounts
tasks.description: Create free tier accounts on AWS, GCP, and Azure and verify access to the console.

milestones.title: IAM and security basics
milestones.outcome: Configure secure identity and access controls across providers.

tasks.title: Read IAM best‑practice guide
tasks.description: Study the AWS IAM Best Practices whitepaper (or equivalent docs for GCP/Azure).

tasks.title: Create a least‑privilege user group
tasks.description: In each cloud console, create a user group with read‑only permissions and attach it to a test user.

tasks.title: Enable MFA for root account
tasks.description: Activate multi‑factor authentication on the root account and document the steps.

tasks.title: Write a short policy review note
tasks.description: Explain why the created policies follow the principle of least privilege.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop networking, compute, storage, and cost‑management expertise.

milestones.title: Networking design
milestones.outcome: Design VPC/VNet architectures with subnets, routing, and security groups.

tasks.title: Read VPC design guide
tasks.description: Study the AWS VPC Design Guide (or GCP VPC documentation) focusing on subnets and route tables.

tasks.title: Create a multi‑AZ VPC
tasks.description: Build a VPC with public and private subnets across two availability zones and attach a NAT gateway.

tasks.title: Configure security groups
tasks.description: Set inbound/outbound rules for a web server and a database tier following least‑privilege principles.

tasks.title: Diagram the network
tasks.description: Use draw.io to produce a clear network diagram and label CIDR blocks.

milestones.title: Compute & storage mastery
milestones.outcome: Provision and manage scalable compute and storage resources.

tasks.title: Read EC2 and S3 deep‑dive docs
tasks.description: Study the official AWS EC2 and S3 documentation sections on performance and durability.

tasks.title: Launch an auto‑scaling group
tasks.description: Create an Auto Scaling group with launch template, scaling policies, and health checks.

tasks.title: Set up encrypted bucket lifecycle
tasks.description: Create an S3 bucket with default encryption, versioning, and a lifecycle rule to transition to Glacier.

tasks.title: Benchmark instance types
tasks.description: Run a simple CPU and I/O benchmark on two instance types and record results.

tasks.title: Write a short lessons‑learned note
tasks.description: Summarize which compute/storage combos performed best for the benchmark scenario.

milestones.title: Cost management fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud spend.

tasks.title: Read AWS Cost Explorer tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the official Cost Explorer walkthrough on the AWS website.

tasks.title: Tag resources for cost allocation
tasks.description: Apply consistent cost‑allocation tags to all resources created in previous tasks.

tasks.title: Create a budget alarm
tasks.description: Set up a budget with a notification alarm when spend exceeds 70% of the monthly limit.

tasks.title: Analyze last‑month bill sample
tasks.description: Download a sample billing report and identify top three cost drivers.

tasks.title: Propose one optimization
tasks.description: Write a brief recommendation to reduce cost based on the analysis.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Build portfolio projects that demonstrate end‑to‑end cloud solutions.

milestones.title: 3‑tier web app deployment
milestones.outcome: Deploy a scalable web app with front‑end, API, and database layers on a cloud provider.

tasks.title: Plan architecture on paper
tasks.description: Sketch the three‑tier design, noting VPC, subnets, load balancer, and database choices.

tasks.title: Provision infrastructure with IaC
tasks.description: Use Terraform (free) to create VPC, ALB, EC2 instances, and RDS according to the plan.

tasks.title: Deploy sample app code
tasks.description: Clone a simple Node.js app from GitHub and deploy it to the EC2 instances via user data script.

tasks.title: Set up monitoring and alerts
tasks.description: Configure CloudWatch (or equivalent) dashboards for CPU, latency, and error rates with alarms.

tasks.title: Document deployment steps
tasks.description: Write a concise README with architecture diagram and IaC commands.

milestones.title: Cost‑optimised architecture write‑up
milestones.outcome: Produce a detailed report showing how to reduce spend for a given workload.

tasks.title: Select a reference workload
tasks.description: Choose a common workload (e.g., data processing pipeline) from a case study.

tasks.title: Identify cost‑heavy components
tasks.description: Map the workload to services and estimate monthly cost using the pricing calculator.

tasks.title: Research reserved/spot options
tasks.description: Find applicable Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, or Spot pricing for each component.

tasks.title: Write optimisation recommendations
tasks.description: Create a 2‑page report with concrete changes, expected savings, and implementation steps.

tasks.title: Peer‑review with a colleague
tasks.description: Share the report with a peer and incorporate feedback.

milestones.title: Associate‑level certification prep
milestones.outcome: Pass an AWS, GCP, or Azure associate certification exam.

tasks.title: Choose certification exam
tasks.description: Select AWS Solutions Architect Associate, GCP Associate Cloud Engineer, or Azure Administrator Associate.

tasks.title: Follow free exam guide
tasks.description: Study the official exam guide and free practice questions on the provider’s site.

tasks.title: Take a timed practice test
tasks.description: Complete a full‑length practice exam under timed conditions.

tasks.title: Review incorrect answers
tasks.description: Analyze each wrong answer, noting the knowledge gap and referencing docs.

tasks.title: Schedule the real exam
tasks.description: Book the exam slot and prepare required identification and payment.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced topics, professional habits, and job‑search readiness.

milestones.title: Advanced security & compliance
milestones.outcome: Implement encryption, logging, and compliance controls for production workloads.

tasks.title: Read CIS benchmark for AWS
tasks.description: Study the free CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark to understand required controls.

tasks.title: Enable CloudTrail multi‑region
tasks.description: Turn on CloudTrail across all regions and send logs to a secure S3 bucket.

tasks.title: Configure KMS‑encrypted volumes
tasks.description: Create a KMS key and attach it to EBS volumes for at‑rest encryption.

tasks.title: Run a compliance scan
tasks.description: Use AWS Config (or equivalent) to evaluate resources against the benchmark rules.

tasks.title: Summarize compliance posture
tasks.description: Write a brief compliance summary highlighting any gaps and remediation steps.

milestones.title: Professional DevOps habits
milestones.outcome: Adopt CI/CD, monitoring, and documentation practices used in cloud teams.

tasks.title: Set up GitHub Actions pipeline
tasks.description: Create a workflow that lints, tests, and deploys infrastructure code on push.

tasks.title: Integrate automated tests
tasks.description: Write a simple integration test that validates an endpoint after deployment.

tasks.title: Configure centralized logging
tasks.description: Route application logs to CloudWatch Logs (or Stackdriver) and set retention policies.

tasks.title: Write run‑book for incidents
tasks.description: Document step‑by‑step procedures for common failure scenarios.

tasks.title: Share run‑book with a mentor
tasks.description: Discuss the run‑book with an experienced engineer and gather feedback.

milestones.title: Job & client readiness
milestones.outcome: Present a polished portfolio and demonstrate interview readiness.

tasks.title: Create an online portfolio site
tasks.description: Build a simple static site (GitHub Pages) showcasing projects, write‑ups, and certifications.

tasks.title: Prepare STAR stories
tasks.description: Write three STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) examples highlighting cloud problem‑solving.

tasks.title: Mock technical interview
tasks.description: Pair with a peer to run a mock interview focusing on design and cost‑optimization questions.

tasks.title: Update LinkedIn with badges
tasks.description: Add earned certifications and a link to the portfolio site on your LinkedIn profile.

tasks.title: Apply to three senior roles
tasks.description: Tailor your resume for each role and submit applications, tracking responses.
